command: echo '=== UNIT ==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service --no-pager -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ExecStartPre; echo '=== DROPIN CONTENT ==='; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service --no-pager 2>&1 | sed -n '1,220p'; echo '=== EXACT DB SUBJECTS ==='; for f in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db; do echo SUBJECT:$f; if sudo -n test -e "$f"; then sudo -n stat -c 'type=%F size=%s mtime=%y mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g' "$f"; sudo -n readlink -f "$f"; sudo -n sha256sum "$f"; else echo MISSING; fi; done; echo '=== DURABLE SAME-NAME CANDIDATES ==='; sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data -xdev -type f \( -name 'consciousness.db' -o -name 'unified.db' -o -name 'amygdala.db' -o -name 'world_experience.db' \) -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>&1 | sort; echo '=== GUARD SOURCE ON PRODUCT CHECKOUT ==='; for f in /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf; do echo SUBJECT:$f; if test -f "$f"; then sha256sum "$f"; sed -n '1,180p' "$f"; else echo MISSING; fi; done
